dossier.claim: A possibility, hypothesis, limited comparison, or secondhand knowledge can become a more definite claim. Some examples also replace the proposed explanation with a different one.
dossier.sourcePattern: Rin guesses why the archery range is lavish, considers Ayako’s previous lack of interest, and cannot state a field’s location definitively. Other lines describe an attack condition, an absence of reported replication, a probable accident, particular combatants, or a park’s current appearance.
dossier.englishEffect: The chair’s passion and construction decision become facts; Ayako’s possible disinterest becomes not finding the right person. A conditional heart-piercing becomes a predicted attack. Lack of reports becomes impossible replication, this Archer’s disadvantage becomes a class-wide rule, and the park’s bleak appearance becomes a claim about why it was built.
dossier.limits: A first-person statement is not automatically an objective guarantee, and narrative context can keep an apparent assertion provisional. There is no danger can concern the present inspection, while an explicitly named premonition remains subjective even when expressed strongly. The dossier therefore focuses on specific strengthened or broadened propositions, not every omitted hedge.
dossier.diagnostic: 381 findings in this category; 8 cited passages.
